description: A cartoon of the top deck of a big white passenger ship at sunset. A woman in a pink swimsuit leaps off the edge into the deck pool and throws up a huge splash. Around the pool stand rows of red, blue and yellow sun loungers under red-and-white striped parasols on the wooden deck, and a steward in a white uniform and cap carries a tray of cocktails along it. Two striped funnels rise behind, seagulls circle, and beyond the rail the sea is turquoise with a palm island and a big orange sun on the horizon.
true_sentence: Best vacation ever! She is jumping into the pool!
false_sentence: Best vacation ever! She is jumping into the sea!

description: A grey-blue front door swings open from the inside, showing the hallway of the house behind it: polished wooden floorboards, a carpeted staircase with a striped runner and pictures on the wall. A golden retriever puppy in a mint green bucket hat, a purple harness and a red lead comes trotting out of the hallway, over the threshold and down the brick front steps of the house. Outside, it walks along the pavement in the sunshine with its owner's legs and red lead beside it, past a wooden fence, front gardens and a parked car, tongue out and hat still on.
true_sentence: The puppy is leaving home. He thinks his hat is great.
false_sentence: The kitten is leaving home. He thinks his hat is great.

description: A soft watercolour of a girl on a village path at sunset. She reaches up and pulls open the flap of a big wooden mailbox on a tall post, and a fan of letters bursts out of it; more envelopes drift through the pink sky and one large envelope floats past the bottom of the frame. Hedges, a tiled cottage roof and a half-timbered house sit behind her.
true_sentence: Bro, so much mail! The mailbox is exploding!
false_sentence: Bro, so much mail! The bin is exploding!

description: A woman in lilac pyjamas stands in a sunlit room full of houseplants and draws a pale wooden brush down her very long dark hair, sweeping it forward over her shoulder. She turns, laughing, then kneels on a patterned rug and brushes her golden retriever's coat with the same brush, finishing with her arm around the dog as both look at the camera.
true_sentence: She is brushing her hair, then the dog. Same brush, bro!
false_sentence: She is brushing her hair, then the cat. Same brush, bro!

description: A photograph taken at sunset on a flat grassy plain with a low white farmhouse in the distance. A man in a black beret and a work shirt lifts a heavy iron grill rack loaded with racks of ribs off a long open fire pit, sending a shower of orange sparks up. The pit below is full of burning logs and a thick bed of pale ash. A rough wooden table on the left holds a mate gourd with a metal straw, and the pit itself is framed with thick wooden beams.
true_sentence: The wood is burning, and the ribs are almost ready!
false_sentence: The wood is burning, and the fish is almost ready!

description: Two boys of about sixteen or seventeen lie side by side over the back of a sofa in a living room, game controllers in their hands, playing a shooting game on a big television. One pulls a furious face and bares his teeth at the screen while the other laughs. They drop the controllers and start grappling, arms round each other's necks, shouting and laughing, and end up in a hug. The clip cuts to a garden where a group of boys the same age, in shorts and t-shirts, stand barefoot on the grass around a brick oven and a barbecue.
true_sentence: Two teenagers are gaming. One blames the controller, bro.
false_sentence: Two teenagers are sleeping. One blames the controller, bro.

description: A pencil sketch of a woodland floor seen close up. A large mushroom with a thick stalk and a smooth domed cap grows straight out of the ground, its gills drawn in fine lines underneath. A hand comes in from the right and a finger touches the base of the stalk at ground level. Fallen leaves, twigs and smaller mushrooms cover the earth all around, with bare trees sketched softly in the background.
true_sentence: A finger is touching a mushroom on the ground. Dinner?
false_sentence: A finger is touching a flower on the ground. Dinner?

description: An older man in a flat cap and a dark knitted cardigan stands at the stern rail of a ferry crossing the Bosphorus at dusk, with the wake churning white behind him and a domed mosque and the city skyline on the shore. He holds a torn piece of bread in one hand and holds crumbs out in the other. One big white and grey sea bird glides in from the left at head height with its wings fully spread; then a second and a third arrive, and by the end of the clip a dozen of them are hanging in the air all around him, wings out and red beaks open, some almost within touching distance while he laughs.
true_sentence: He has one piece of bread, and a hundred seagulls want it!
false_sentence: He has one piece of bread, and a hundred pigeons want it!

description: A drawing of a city street at night in heavy rain, lit pink and blue by neon buildings and glowing signs. A young man in a long black hooded coat and white trainers strides across the striped crossing in the middle of the road. Cars are stopped on both sides of him with their headlights on, and other people in raincoats walk across in front of and behind him. The wet road throws back the coloured light in long reflections and rain streaks the air.
true_sentence: He is crossing the road. He thinks he stopped the traffic.
false_sentence: He is crossing the bridge. He thinks he stopped the traffic.

description: A young woman in a neon yellow vest stands on an outdoor basketball court breathing hard with her mouth open after playing. She presses her flat hand onto her chest over her heart and looks down, still panting. A man in a green shirt comes up beside her, puts his hand on her shoulder and stares wide-eyed at the camera; the two of them then lean over the smartwatch on her wrist and both react in shock at the number on it while other players carry on with the ball behind them.
true_sentence: Her heart is beating so fast! Even the watch is scared!
false_sentence: Her heart is beating so fast! Even the phone is scared!

description: A photograph taken at dusk in a narrow cobbled street between old colonial houses with lit windows and glowing wall lamps. In the middle a young drummer marches towards the camera wearing an enormous headdress of green, blue and gold feathers and a matching feathered shoulder piece over a bare chest, a big wooden barrel drum slung at his waist and a beater raised in his hand. Behind and beside him a whole band of drummers in bright shirts play more drums, dancers in gold costumes move among them, and paper streamers in green, yellow and pink fly through the air with bunting strung overhead and the low sun burning at the end of the street.
true_sentence: Festival report: a little bit loud, a few feathers.
false_sentence: Festival report: a little bit loud, a few balloons.

description: On a wide white-sand beach under a clear blue sky, a man in red shorts crouches between two tall stacks of turquoise sun loungers. He lifts both stacks at once onto his shoulders and walks across the sand carrying them, the loungers towering far above his head so only his legs and red shorts are visible beneath. He crosses the empty beach past parasols and the sea, then sets the whole load down and lines the loungers up in a row with the others.
true_sentence: What a load! He is carrying twenty sun loungers!
false_sentence: What a load! He is carrying twenty surfboards!

description: A soft watercolour of a young woman standing in a sunlit meadow with her eyes closed and her face tipped up; huge dandelion clocks in the foreground are shedding clouds of white seed parachutes that drift sideways across the picture on the moving air, her hair is lifted to one side, and golden sunbeams slant down through the grass and wildflowers.
true_sentence: A light breeze and a million seeds. Just a quiet day.
false_sentence: A light breeze and a million bees. Just a quiet day.

description: A young woman with a blonde plait pushes open a different window in every shot and leans out into the view behind it. First a white casement window over an old-town courtyard of pastel houses with shutters and potted plants; then a wooden chalet window opening onto a green alpine meadow under a blue sky; then a window straight onto a sandy beach and turquoise sea; then a big wooden chalet window framing a snowy mountain peak, which she pushes wide open and leans through, smiling.
true_sentence: Bro, her window opens onto a beach. The rent must be crazy.
false_sentence: Bro, her window opens onto a desert. The rent must be crazy.

description: A soft pastel cartoon of the inside of a bus, seen from behind the passengers. The driver sits at the wheel in a dark blue uniform and peaked cap, smiling broadly with one hand raised in a wave to the people getting on. A ticket roll unspools from the dashboard beside him. In the foreground, a woman in pink, two small children and a boy holding a fluffy dog look up at him, one child waving back. Sunlight comes through the windscreen and the open door.
true_sentence: Welcome to the bus. The smile is free, the ticket is not.
false_sentence: Welcome to the plane. The smile is free, the ticket is not.

description: A grinning young cook in a white coat and a white cap builds a big bowl of koshari on a steel counter in a busy restaurant. He starts from a white bowl of cooked rice, tips brown lentils out of a ladle onto it, piles tubes of pasta round the edge, then pours a big ladle of red tomato sauce over the whole heap and tops it with crispy fried onions. Loose grains of rice are scattered all over the counter.
true_sentence: Bro is throwing rice, lentils and pasta in one bowl. Legend!
false_sentence: Bro is throwing rice, lentils and pasta in one pan. Legend!

description: An art-deco poster of a theatre interior. A man in a gold and black geometric suit stands alone in a bright spotlight on the stage, one hand pressed to his heart and the other flung out, head thrown back as he declaims. Heavy crimson and gold curtains are swagged back on either side of the stage, and rows of empty seats stretch away into the dark behind him.
true_sentence: He is giving his heart to an empty theatre! Nobody came!
false_sentence: He is giving his heart to an empty stadium! Nobody came!

description: Top-down view of two people standing toe to toe on a wooden floor. One wears bright yellow slippers with big googly eyes and a pink tongue sticking out; the other wears a matching set in green. They shuffle their feet until the two sets line up facing each other like cartoon monsters.
true_sentence: Each has two slippers, so each has a pair. Easy maths.
false_sentence: Each has two boots, so each has a pair. Easy maths.

description: An ink-style drawing of the side of a wooden apartment building. Big white sheets and shirts are pegged out on lines strung between the balconies, billowing in the wind. A person in a grey robe leans on the iron balcony railing looking down at the street, with potted plants beside them, telephone poles and swirling clouds behind.
true_sentence: The sheets are drying, and the wind is trying to steal them!
false_sentence: The rugs are drying, and the wind is trying to steal them!

description: A woman in a cream coat holds a cluster of pale pink cherry blossoms up to her face, closes her eyes and breathes in the scent; a bee is crawling over the petals. She lowers the branch and smiles, standing under a huge cherry tree in full flower, then walks into an avenue where the blossoming branches meet overhead and spreads her arms wide.
true_sentence: She is smelling the flowers. The bee is not happy about it.
false_sentence: She is smelling the flowers. The cat is not happy about it.

description: A pen-and-ink drawing of a narrow alley between old brick houses. A young man in a shalwar kameez swings a cricket bat at a tennis ball that is right in front of the bat face; his eyes are locked on the ball and his brow is furrowed. Boys sit on a wall behind him watching, another man watches from a doorstep, tangled electric wires cross overhead and dust puffs up around his feet.
true_sentence: Total focus! That tennis ball has no chance!
false_sentence: Total focus! That football has no chance!

description: By a resort swimming pool at sunset, a woman in a short gold dress poses with one hand in her hair while a man in a white vest crouches down to photograph her with his phone. The camera closes in on her face and she smiles broadly at the lens, showing her teeth, with gold hoop earrings and palm trees behind her. The two of them then lean together over the phone to look at the photos, laughing, and she gives a thumbs up. In the last shot she walks back towards the pool and he lifts the phone to take another picture.
true_sentence: She is smiling like a model. He thinks he is a pro.
false_sentence: She is frowning like a model. He thinks he is a pro.

description: A warm illustration set in the hallway of an old house. A little girl in a red patterned dress and pigtails comes flying down the staircase, one arm swinging a leather school satchel, the other stretched out ahead of her. At the bottom a man in a tweed jacket and tie has dropped into a crouch with both arms wide open to catch her, grinning up at her. A grandfather clock, a coat rack with hats and coats, a patterned rug and the front door fill the hall behind them.
true_sentence: Dad is catching his daughter. The bag will hit him first.
false_sentence: Mum is catching her daughter. The bag will hit her first.

description: In a cartoon mountain cabin, a man sits at a table holding his aching head. His friend hands him a small white pill and pours a glass of water; he swallows the pill, drinks, and soon smiles feeling better.
true_sentence: One little pill, and he is a new man!
false_sentence: One little cookie, and he is a new man!

description: A retro cartoon illustration of a living room. A woman in a blue jumper and brown skirt bends forward with both gloved hands pressed to her open mouth, her eyes wide and her hair flying back, with jagged shock lines drawn around her head. On the floor beside her stands a cream rotary telephone; its handset has been dropped and hangs swinging on its coiled cord, with motion lines showing it still moving. A brown sofa and a table lamp stand behind her.
true_sentence: Bestie, she has dropped the telephone. Big news, I bet!
false_sentence: Bestie, she has dropped the teapot. Big news, I bet!

description: In a cartoon park a big goose steals a family's picnic basket; while her parents cower behind the fence, a small red-haired girl clenches her fists, marches straight at the goose, stares it down and takes the basket back - then her parents lift her up like a champion with a trophy.
true_sentence: Such brave parents! They are hiding behind a fence.
false_sentence: Such brave parents! They are hiding behind a tree.

description: A photograph taken from above of nine people in business suits seated around a large round wooden conference table in a formal wood-panelled room. Small national flags of different countries stand on the table in front of empty places, each beside a folder and a sheet of paper. The nine lean in from all sides of the table and stack their hands together in the middle, talking as they do it, while a loose sheet of paper falls through the air over the table.
true_sentence: The committee is stacking nine hands. Decisions made: zero.
false_sentence: The committee is stacking five hands. Decisions made: zero.

description: In a 3D-animated gym, a huge strongman grips a loaded barbell, strains as he pulls it from the floor, and presses it triumphantly over his head with a proud grin before setting it down.
true_sentence: He is lifting the barbell. Now he thinks he is a superhero.
false_sentence: He is lifting the sofa. Now he thinks he is a superhero.

description: An illustration of a man in a colour-blocked polo shirt standing at a wall, lifting the top sheet of a pinned-up calendar with one hand and turning the page over with the other. The sheet underneath shows a grid of squares with one square ringed in red. A red marker hangs from a string beside the calendar and three blank notes are pinned to the wall below it.
true_sentence: He is turning to a new month. One red circle. Payday?
false_sentence: He is turning to a new month. One blue circle. Payday?

description: In a Pixar-style street court a tall girl in a yellow jersey dribbles between two defenders, drives to the hoop, leaps and dunks the ball, then hangs on the rim as everyone hugs and celebrates.
true_sentence: Yo, she is dunking the basketball. Boys, take notes!
false_sentence: Yo, she is missing the basketball hoop. Boys, take notes!

description: A comic-style illustration on a building site. A young workman in a yellow hard hat sits on a metal stepladder in front of an open grey fuse box on a wooden wall, with a small screwdriver held in his teeth. He holds red-handled pliers in one gloved hand and a bundle of cut red, green and blue wires in the other, and looks up at the row of circuit breakers he is working on. Coils of cable hang over his shoulder and lie on the floor, with a tool belt on his hip and a work light behind him.
true_sentence: He is repairing the fuse box. The last guy messed it up.
false_sentence: He is repairing the car. The last guy messed it up.

description: On a lantern-lit rooftop at dusk, an animated young woman pulls her friend close and whispers a secret into her ear; the friend gasps, they both press fingers to their lips going shh, then sit side by side acting innocent when a man peeks over and asks what they are doing.
true_sentence: Bestie, she is whispering a secret, and he is dying to know.
false_sentence: Bestie, she is shouting a secret, and he is dying to know.

description: A soft painted portrait of a young person filling the whole frame from the top of the head to the base of the neck. They have tousled mid brown hair, thick dark eyebrows, large brown eyes with small white highlights, pink cheeks and a small closed lipped smile. Below the mouth the rounded chin and the line of the jaw stand out clearly against the pale neck, and behind them is a blurred wash of green meadow and blue sky.
true_sentence: The painting shows the face down to the chin and neck.
false_sentence: The painting shows the face down to the knees.

description: In a Pixar-style 3D animation, a girl in a red parka stands by a stone hut on a snowy mountain and pulls the rope of a flagpole with her mittens. A folded teal flag rises up the pole, unfurls with a white stripe and golden sun, and she salutes it proudly as it waves against the peaks.
true_sentence: She is raising the flag on the mountain. So proud, so cold!
false_sentence: She is raising the flag on the beach. So proud, so cold!

description: A hand-drawn comic-style picture with thick black outlines, flat colours and motion lines. A grinning man with round white eyes, a patched apron, big yellow rubber gloves and brown shoes swings a mop across a blue-and-cream chequered floor. Sparkle stars and soap bubbles pop off the wet tiles. A grey mop bucket on castors, full of suds and fitted with a wringer, stands to the right. Behind him are office windows with a drawn city skyline, a potted fern and a radiator.
true_sentence: Cartoon floors sparkle. My cheap mop can't do that.
false_sentence: Cartoon ceilings sparkle. My cheap mop can't do that.

description: An animated girl at an indoor pool straps blue swim goggles over her eyes, gives a thumbs up to her coach, then dives in and swims underwater wearing them.
true_sentence: She is putting her goggles on. The pool is hers now!
false_sentence: She is putting her sunglasses on. The pool is hers now!

description: A soft cartoon illustration of a plump green caterpillar with yellow stripes resting along a big green leaf in a sunny garden. It has a small smiling face with pink cheeks and a row of little round legs gripping the leaf. A bite-shaped piece is missing from the edge of the leaf just in front of it, with one crumb of leaf floating away. Behind it are rounded bushes, pink, blue and yellow flowers and sparkles of light.
true_sentence: The leaf is missing a bite. The insect blames the snail.
false_sentence: The flower is missing a bite. The insect blames the snail.

description: A Pixar-style craftsman in goggles gleefully smashes blue ceramic tiles with a hammer, breaking a whole stack into small shards; he accidentally knocks a clay pot off the bench so it shatters too, then arranges the broken pieces into a colorful mosaic sun.
true_sentence: He is breaking tiles. The pot? He says that was art too.
false_sentence: He is breaking plates. The pot? He says that was art too.

description: A soft illustration of a small village shop seen from the customer's side of the counter. A dark-haired young shop worker in a floral apron leans over the wooden counter and holds out a single coin between his fingers, while the customer's two open hands reach up from the bottom of the frame to take it. In his other hand he holds a jar he has just scanned. Behind him a conveyor belt carries apples, a pear, oranges and packets towards a paper grocery bag, and shelves of bottles and jars fill the wall.
true_sentence: He is putting one coin in two open hands. Big money!
false_sentence: He is putting one banknote in two open hands. Big money!

description: A young man in a beanie holds a green click pen up to the camera, clicks the button, then writes stripes in blue, red and other colors on a lined notebook and grins about how cool the multi-color pen is.
true_sentence: Bestie, he is showing off a pen. Men and their gadgets!
false_sentence: Bestie, he is showing off a pencil. Men and their gadgets!

description: A cartoon of a den built out of blankets over a sofa in a sunlit living room. Inside it a boy in a blue hoodie holds up a lit torch and points at a stack of cushions, while a girl in dungarees kneels beside him laughing with her hand at her mouth as she eats a sweet. A striped bowl heaped with wrapped and jelly sweets floats between them, with loose sweets scattered around it, under a string of paper stars and hearts. Teddy bears sit on the sofa behind.
true_sentence: She is eating candy and will blame the teddy bears later.
false_sentence: She is eating popcorn and will blame the teddy bears later.

description: On the bench of a sports hall, a physio wraps an elastic bandage around a handball player's wrist and hand, fixes the end, and the player flexes her wrist and gives a thumbs up and a smile.
true_sentence: A bandage on the wrist, a thumbs up. Meeting closed.
false_sentence: A bandage on the knee, a thumbs up. Meeting closed.

description: A loose watercolour and ink drawing of a small corner shop with a striped awning and a wide glass front full of shelves of goods. On the stone step in front of the open door a middle-aged man in a shirt, braces and work trousers laughs with his arms flung wide, a key held in one raised hand, as if showing off the place he owns. A geranium in a terracotta pot stands beside him on the pavement.
true_sentence: Tiny shop, huge pride. His business, his kingdom!
false_sentence: Big supermarket, huge pride. His business, his kingdom!

description: A woman dips a fat makeup brush into a clear jar of loose face powder and taps it, sending up a visible dusty cloud - "A whole cloud!" - which makes her friend gasp. She then gently brushes the powder over the friend's cheeks and nose and declares her "All set".
true_sentence: Too much powder! A whole cloud, and she blames the brush.
false_sentence: Too much glitter! A whole cloud, and she blames the brush.

description: A stylised woodblock-style illustration of a camel with a patterned saddle blanket striding along the top of a desert dune at sunset. The whole bottom half of the picture is one long sweeping ridge of sand that bends across the frame in bands of orange, red and cream, and the camel's neck and the swirling clouds above it repeat the same bending line. A red sun sits low behind it.
true_sentence: The camel is following the dune's curve. No shortcuts.
false_sentence: The horse is following the dune's curve. No shortcuts.

description: In a hand-painted anime rowing race, a determined crew sprints their red boat down a lantern-lined river and crosses the finish line first, breaking the tape. They raise their oars, hug, and carry the rower on their shoulders while the crowd cheers.
true_sentence: Victory! They are crossing the line first and going crazy!
false_sentence: Victory! They are crossing the line last and going crazy!

description: A photograph of a wide sandy beach on a clear day. A woman in a plain black one-piece swimsuit runs up out of the shallows with a pale, well-used surfboard clamped under her right arm. Her hair is wet and pushed back, her arms and legs are muscular, one foot is off the ground and sand sprays out from under her heel. A wave curls and breaks behind her. Two red-and-yellow patrol flags stand in the sand on either side of the frame, and a wooden lifeguard tower sits on the grassy dune behind.
true_sentence: So athletic, bro. She thinks she surfs better than any man.
false_sentence: So athletic, bro. She thinks she skis better than any man.

description: A retro-cartoon man in a green tracksuit drops strawberries, a banana and milk into a blender, blends it into a pink smoothie, opens the lid and gets a blob of smoothie on his nose, tastes it, then pours the drink into a glass and gives a thumbs up.
true_sentence: Cheap blender! Now there is smoothie on his nose!
false_sentence: Cheap toaster! Now there is smoothie on his nose!

description: A low, wide shot straight down a polished wooden table in a wood-panelled hall. Two men in dark suits lean in from opposite sides and shake hands above the table. Between them, open leather folders hold a signed document and a blank sheet, with a black fountain pen resting on the near folder. Behind them stand two flags on poles, one navy and one dark red, and two press photographers firing their camera flashes.
true_sentence: The treaty is signed: one handshake, a hundred flashes.
false_sentence: The treaty is signed: one hug, a hundred flashes.

description: A cartoon man in a purple tracksuit waits in a laundromat and slowly loses his mind from boredom: he watches the clock, balances stacked cups on his head, blows a feather, spins his laundry bag on one finger, slides off his chair and ends up wearing a wet sock on his head.
true_sentence: Total boredom! He is wearing a wet sock on his head now!
false_sentence: Total boredom! He is wearing a wet towel on his head now!

description: A man in a red checked shirt kneels in a wooden canoe on a still turquoise mountain lake, mid-stroke with a wooden paddle. Behind him a wall of snow-capped rocky peaks catches the first low golden light of the morning on its faces while the lower slopes and pine forest are still in cold shadow, and a moose wades in the shallows near the far shore.
true_sentence: He is paddling at dawn. The moose is judging his technique.
false_sentence: He is paddling at dawn. The bear is judging his technique.

description: In a 3D-animated kitchen a mother finds a flower pot knocked over with soil and paw prints on the floor and angrily points at her teenage son; he denies it and points at the dirt trail, and the paw prints lead both of them to point at the guilty cat under the table.
true_sentence: Mum is blaming her son. The paw prints say it was the cat.
false_sentence: Mum is blaming her son. The paw prints say it was the dog.

description: A floodlit football terrace at night. Rows of men and women in dark winter jackets stand shoulder to shoulder, singing with their heads back and their hands pressed to their chests, breath steaming in the cold. Behind them hundreds more hold club scarves in dark red, blue and yellow stretched above their heads in a long line up the stand.
true_sentence: Supporters are singing in the freezing cold. Mildly excited.
false_sentence: Supporters are singing in the hot sun. Mildly excited.

description: In an anime-style clip, a silver-haired older woman draws a wooden bow, aims the arrow with narrowed eyes and hits the bullseye of a straw target; her big bearded companion celebrates and hands her the next arrow.
true_sentence: You hit the bullseye with your bow. He carries the arrows.
false_sentence: You missed the target with your bow. He carries the arrows.

description: A wide dry plain under a pale sky. A young ranch hand in a canvas jacket, denim shirt and leather chaps rides a bay horse at a trot along a barbed-wire fence, one gloved hand brushing the top of a fence post as he passes. The fence runs dead straight away to the horizon, dust drifts up behind the horse, and a windmill and flat-topped mesas stand far off in the haze.
true_sentence: He is riding along the ranch fence. 400 posts to go.
false_sentence: He is walking along the ranch fence. 400 posts to go.

description: Two animated tourists sit on the steps of a lion fountain flipping through a thick travel book of photos; they match the lion fountain on the page to the real one behind them, then point at the Leaning Tower page and run off to find it, book under arm.
true_sentence: Bro, they are checking the guidebook. Yep, same lion.
false_sentence: Bro, they are checking the guidebook. Yep, same horse.

description: A cartoon-style illustration of a young person outdoors in blazing heat. The face is flushed deep red, big drops of sweat run down the forehead, cheeks and neck and fly off in all directions, the eyes are half shut and the teeth are clenched in a grimace. One hand is pressed against the forehead pushing the damp hair back, and the background is a blurred golden street glaring with sunlight.
true_sentence: So hot! This poor soul is suffering in the midday sun!
false_sentence: So cold! This poor soul is suffering in the snow!

description: In a 3D-animated hay field a kid pinky-promises a big farmer to catch him; the man does a trust fall, the kid steps aside and he crashes into the hay, sitting up covered in straw and betrayed while the kid grins.
true_sentence: The kid betrays him. His excuse: the hay is softer.
false_sentence: The kid betrays him. His excuse: the water is softer.

description: A colour comic-style illustration of a bedroom. A young woman with brown hair has pulled both mirrored doors of a tall wooden wardrobe wide open and stands in the opening with her arms stretched out, eyes wide, as a mass of assorted things bursts out over her: shirts, jumpers, trousers and skirts in red, green, blue, yellow and pink, folded stacks toppling off the shelves, and a brown leather shoe flying out of the frame towards the viewer. Empty wooden hangers swing on the rail above her, a battered suitcase sits on top of the wardrobe, and a patterned rug, a potted plant and a pair of jeans lie on the floor.
true_sentence: Nothing to wear? Her wardrobe is spitting out so much stuff!
false_sentence: Nothing to wear? Her fridge is spitting out so much stuff!

description: Three roped mountain climbers in colorful jackets push forward step by step up a snowy ridge, advancing toward an orange flag planted on the summit; they reach the top together and throw their arms up in triumph.
true_sentence: Team update: we are advancing to the top. Deadline: today.
false_sentence: Team update: we are advancing to the lake. Deadline: today.

description: A soft watercolour of a doctor's consulting room. A doctor in a white coat with a stethoscope round her neck stands with her back to us, one hand on a boy's knee. The boy sits on a green examination couch with his sleeve pushed up, holding his upper arm. Behind them are a cream cabinet with a tray of pens and papers, a blank framed notice on the wall and a potted plant. A blood-pressure cuff and its bulb lie on the counter in the foreground. Through the open door a woman and a small girl in yellow wait on chairs outside.
true_sentence: The boy is at the surgery. No school tomorrow, he hopes.
false_sentence: The boy is at the hairdresser. No school tomorrow, he hopes.

description: In a Pixar-style kitchen, a woman in a striped apron drops a sugar cube into a glass of water and stirs it with a spoon. The cube breaks up and vanishes completely, and she holds up the clear glass with wide surprised eyes saying it is all gone.
true_sentence: The sugar is dissolving. She is looking for it in the glass.
false_sentence: The ice is dissolving. She is looking for it in the glass.

description: An animated woman waits happily at a candlelit rooftop dinner table with spaghetti and a wrapped gift, waving as her partner arrives. He apologetically tells her he cannot stay and leaves, and she is left crying alone at the table, staring sadly at the untouched dinner and present.
true_sentence: He is leaving. How disappointing! Who will eat the pasta?
false_sentence: He is leaving. How disappointing! Who will eat the pizza?

description: A charcoal drawing filling the frame with the outer skin of a tree trunk: thick ridges, deep cracks and hard flaking plates, with patches of lichen. A hand at the right pulls a long broken strip away from the trunk, and small crumbs fall from it against the pale background.
true_sentence: Bro, this bark is so rough. Free sandpaper!
false_sentence: Bro, this glass is so rough. Free sandpaper!

description: In a 3D-animated climbing gym, a young woman fights her way up a tall climbing wall, gritting her teeth, slipping and dangling on the rope but refusing to quit. She hauls herself over the top edge and raises both fists as the crowd below cheers.
true_sentence: She keeps slipping, but she overcomes her fear!
false_sentence: She keeps slipping, so she gives up and goes home!

description: Close-up of two clay-covered hands shaping a wet pot on a turning potter's wheel. The upper part is already a smooth thrown neck with curled clay handles; the lower part is still a rough lump. Specks of wet clay are flung across the wooden wheel head and the bench. Behind, out of focus, wooden shelves hold rows of finished pots and lumps of raw clay, with wooden tools lying on a bench.
true_sentence: Clay everywhere. It is a craft, not a mess, or so they say.
false_sentence: Paint everywhere. It is a craft, not a mess, or so they say.

description: In a wood, a man in a blue T-shirt and work gloves cuts into a standing tree trunk with a chainsaw. A life-size bear is already emerging from the pale wood, and he saws around its shoulders and body, sending a spray of sawdust out to the side while the bark below is cut away to free the bear's legs.
true_sentence: He is sawing a bear out of a tree. I can't even draw one.
false_sentence: He is sawing a horse out of a tree. I can't even draw one.

description: A freediver in a black wetsuit and long carbon fins hangs head-down far below the surface of deep blue open water, sliding down beside a pale guide rope that runs from the sunlit surface into the dark water below him. Small bubbles trail up from his mask towards the light above.
true_sentence: He is diving down a rope to a depth where fish look worried.
false_sentence: He is rising from a depth where fish look worried.

description: A man walks through Times Square holding a phone on a gimbal and filming himself. In a film studio a hand holds a clapperboard reading ACTION in front of a cinema camera on a tripod under a large softbox. A white drone with four propellers hovers low over a green field, flattening the grass beneath it. An aerial shot glides over rolling green and yellow farmland. Back in the studio the crew claps and cheers behind a camera operator.
true_sentence: A drone is flattening the grass. Farmers will love it.
false_sentence: A tractor is flattening the grass. Farmers will love it.

description: An ink drawing on aged paper. A woman in a blue robe and a conical straw hat stands on a rocky cliff edge with her arm stretched out towards the land below her. Beneath her lies a wide valley: a patchwork of green and gold fields, a broad river winding through it, small villages of tiled roofs, and a walled town on a hill in the distance. Snow-capped mountains close the horizon, birds fly below the cliff and tall grass leans in the wind in the foreground.
true_sentence: She is pointing at the whole country as if she owns it.
false_sentence: She is pointing at the whole sea as if she owns it.

description: A selfie-POV clip through a Portuguese city. A young man holds the camera at arm's length while riding on the open step of a yellow tram down a steep narrow street at sunset. Next he walks along a building whose whole facade is covered in blue-and-white painted tiles; he presses his palm flat against them and looks up the wall. Then he is at a marble cafe table, breaking into a sugar-dusted custard tart with a fork beside an espresso, and eating it with a delighted look at the camera.
true_sentence: He is touching the tiles but thinking about the tart.
false_sentence: He is touching the trees but thinking about the tart.

description: A formal meeting in a tall wood-panelled room with a blue flag on a stand and daylight through a shuttered window. A woman in a dark suit stands and leans over the long table, setting down an open buff folder of documents in front of the others. Loose white sheets and a notepad lie on the polished wood beside a glass water jug. Five colleagues in suits, some seated and some standing behind the leather chairs, watch her place the folder.
true_sentence: She is handing over the papers. Someone else forgot them.
false_sentence: She is tearing up the papers. Someone else forgot them.

description: A selfie-style shot inside the dark corridor of a haunted-house attraction, the walls lined with neon strips and glowing signs. A woman with a lilac bob in a denim jacket and a man in a yellow hoodie edge forward with their eyes wide and their mouths open. A grinning zombie head lights up on the wall beside them, then a clown mask appears further down the passage. The two clutch each other, the woman gripping his arm and then his shoulder, and both scream straight into the camera as they back away.
true_sentence: Absolute terror! They are screaming at a clown mask!
false_sentence: Absolute terror! They are screaming at a spider!

description: A photograph on the Great Wall at sunrise. A woman in a red jacket and black trousers walks straight towards the camera along the brick walkway with her arms held out wide, a cream paper parasol in her left hand. Behind her the wall drops away to a square stone watchtower, and beyond that the wall and its towers climb over one wooded ridge after another until they fade into the mist and the pale gold sun far away.
true_sentence: She is walking the Great Wall. Just a small distance left.
false_sentence: She is cycling the Great Wall. Just a small distance left.

description: A montage of people in the air. Two tandem skydivers hang under a canopy above a patchwork of green and brown fields with clouds below them. A woman swings in a harness under a rainbow paraglider wing over an alpine valley. A hot-air balloon drifts at sunrise with two passengers leaning on the basket rim. Then a group of skydivers falls through blue sky, and in the last shot about twenty of them have joined hands into a single wide ring against the clouds.
true_sentence: Twenty skydivers, one ring formation, zero late arrivals.
false_sentence: Five skydivers, one ring formation, zero late arrivals.

description: A wood-panelled courtroom lit by tall windows. A woman in a black robe sits behind the raised bench and brings a wooden gavel down onto its block, papers spread in front of her and a set of brass scales standing at the edge of the bench. In the foreground a stack of files lies on the counsel table.
true_sentence: The dog ate my homework? The judge is banging her gavel.
false_sentence: The dog ate my homework? The judge is banging her shoe.

description: A young man in a grey vest stands at the door of a yellow-and-turquoise tiled shower and turns the tap. Water pours from the shower head; he holds his hand under the stream to test the temperature and pulls it back. Then he is under the shower himself, bare-chested and drenched, water running down his face and body as he works shampoo into his hair.
true_sentence: Cheap boiler: he tests the shower, then gets soaked anyway.
false_sentence: Cheap boiler: he tests the bath, then gets soaked anyway.

description: A bright cartoon of a small boy who has tipped his chair too far. He is caught mid-fall, leaning back with the blue and yellow chair going over behind him, both front legs off the floor and his trainers kicking up in the air. His eyes and mouth are wide open, his arms fly out to the sides, and motion lines show the chair swinging over. Beside him is the table he was sitting at, a green chair still standing, and a patterned rug on the wooden floor.
true_sentence: He is falling backwards. Later he will blame the chair.
false_sentence: He is falling forwards. Later he will blame the chair.

description: A woman opens a built-in white closet full of tightly packed clothes on two rails with shoe boxes underneath. Another woman in a blue shirt pulls open the double doors of a tall wooden cupboard, revealing two rails of colourful blouses, shirts and trousers arranged by colour with storage boxes above and clear shoe boxes below. The film then cuts to a huge bright walk-in dressing room lined with shelves of folded knitwear, hanging suits and handbags: a woman stands in the doorway wearing a long champagne-coloured satin gown with wide sleeves and a tied belt reaching to her bare feet, throws her arms out wide and looks around the room in mock astonishment.
true_sentence: She is wearing a satin robe and calling this room tiny.
false_sentence: She is wearing a satin robe and calling this kitchen tiny.

description: A photograph taken from a hilltop on a clear day. A man in a black jacket with a canvas backpack strides past a stack of stones on the stony path, both arms flung out wide, seen from behind. Below him the whole plain is divided into a patchwork of farm fields: green pasture, standing green crops and pale gold fields already cut, separated by hedges and lines of trees, with a river curling through them, farmhouses dotted about and low hills and the sea on the horizon.
true_sentence: He is looking at the crops as if he grew them all himself.
false_sentence: He is looking at the city as if he built it all himself.

description: A student with silver-grey hair, glasses and headphones round his neck sits at a table in a busy study hall covered in small paper cards. He presses one card against his forehead with his eyes closed while he tries to say the answer, then looks at it to check, and works through card after card until the pile in front of him has grown into a heap. At the end he throws his fist up and grins, having got them all.
true_sentence: He is recalling every card. In the exam, nothing.
false_sentence: He is recalling every song. In the exam, nothing.

description: A cartoon bride and groom float in the air in front of a pastel flower arch, kissing. She wears a white gown, a veil and pearls and holds a bouquet up in one hand; he wears a black tuxedo. Confetti and ribbons fall around them while guests in the foreground clap and cheer with their eyes shut.
true_sentence: Day one of marriage: they are floating. Day two: dishes.
false_sentence: Day one of marriage: they are sinking. Day two: dishes.

description: In a salon a stylist combs out a client's very long glossy black hair, then weaves a thick braid along the top of her head and down through the length of the hair; at the end the client stands up and swings the hair, which reaches almost to the floor, with the finished braid running over the crown.
true_sentence: A braid almost to the floor! The stylist needs a holiday.
false_sentence: A braid just to the shoulders! The stylist needs a holiday.

description: A manga-style drawing inside a wooden training hall. A barefoot young man in a dark blue training robe grips a long bamboo sword in both hands and drives forward against an opponent, whose own bamboo sword and gloved hands come in from the left edge of the frame. Speed lines cut across the whole picture, dust bursts from the floorboards under his heel, and a Japanese flag hangs on the wall behind him with a stone garden visible through the open sliding doors.
true_sentence: Full combat mode in the hall. He thinks he is a movie hero.
false_sentence: Full combat mode on the beach. He thinks he is a movie hero.

description: A darkened hall with a red-lit stage at the front where a performer stands beside a microphone stand. In the seats a bearded man in a mustard shirt, sunglasses pushed up on his head, claps his hands together over and over with a broad smile, watching the stage. The rows of people in front of him are clapping too. He grows more enthusiastic and finally raises both hands above his head to keep clapping.
true_sentence: His applause keeps growing. Is the performer his cousin?
false_sentence: His applause keeps shrinking. Is the performer his cousin?

description: A hand-drawn illustration of a male lion standing on the edge of a rocky cliff above an African savanna. His mouth is wide open in a full roar, showing teeth and tongue, and his dark mane is blown back by the wind, drawn as curling white lines around him. Below and behind him dry grass, flat-topped acacia trees and purple hills stretch to the horizon, where a big orange sun is rising.
true_sentence: Such a silent sunrise. Well, apart from the roaring lion.
false_sentence: Such a silent sunrise. Well, apart from the roaring tiger.

description: A bearded man in a bright orange jacket and a grey beanie stands on a grassy clifftop above a grey, white-capped sea. The wind rips his scarf out sideways and flattens the grass; he grabs at his hat to stop it flying off, turns his back to the gust, then bends forward and pushes himself uphill step by step, bracing his hands on his knees as the wind shoves him back.
true_sentence: Struggling against the wind: the best excuse for being late!
false_sentence: Struggling against the snow: the best excuse for being late!

description: A woman in dark overalls reaches up to pull down the metal door of a home garage at sunset; inside are a parked car, bicycles hung on the wall and shelves of boxes.
true_sentence: She is closing the garage door. Somebody always forgets.
false_sentence: She is opening the garage door. Somebody always forgets.

description: A stylized portrait of a young woman with big curly blonde hair, deep red lips and silver jewelry, resting her hand under her chin and gazing upward.
true_sentence: Your silver jewellery is beautiful. Great taste!
false_sentence: Your gold jewellery is beautiful. Great taste!

description: Two smiling 3D-cartoon girls, one dark-haired in a white top and one blonde in a pink dress, stand side by side at a table and hold the same open white book between them, both looking down at its pages.
true_sentence: Two girls are sharing one book. Who turns the page?
false_sentence: Two boys are sharing one book. Who turns the page?

description: A cute 3D-rendered white mouse stands upright on a sunny beach, holding a waffle cone of pink and yellow ice cream in both front paws with its mouth open and tongue out, palm trees and turquoise sea behind it.
true_sentence: A mouse is eating an ice cream bigger than its head!
false_sentence: A mouse is eating a pizza bigger than its head!

description: A barefoot woman unfolds and sets up an ironing board in a bright room, with an iron waiting on the windowsill and a basket of laundry beside her.
true_sentence: This is an ironing board. She needs it for ironing.
false_sentence: This is a surfboard. She needs it for ironing.

description: A young woman with bright pink hair stands in white-and-copper robotic armor on a blurred city street with a pedestrian behind her.
true_sentence: Pink hair, robot armour. Nobody is messing with her today.
false_sentence: Pink hair, a red dress. Nobody is messing with her today.

description: Late at night a man lies in bed wide awake, staring at the ceiling with an arm over his forehead while a clock glows on the nightstand.
true_sentence: Insomnia in bed again. He blames the coffee, of course.
false_sentence: Insomnia on the sofa again. He blames the coffee, of course.

description: An anime-style young woman with long auburn hair wears an orange dress covered in a white floral print, standing before a wall of large orange and white flowers with butterflies around her.
true_sentence: Bro, her floral dress matches the wall. She's invisible.
false_sentence: Bro, her striped dress matches the wall. She's invisible.

description: A 3D-animation-style render of a tiny adorable furry creature with big eyes and pointed ears, wearing a green pointed hat and tunic with a rope belt, holding a twig staff on a sunny forest path with falling leaves.
true_sentence: A little gnome in a green hat thinks he is a great wizard.
false_sentence: A little gnome in a red hat thinks he is a great wizard.

description: A dark silhouette of a person balancing upside down on both hands in shallow water, legs split high in the air, with drops splashing up and ripples spreading around the hands, against a plain orange background.
true_sentence: Doing a handstand in the water? Don't try this at home, bro.
false_sentence: Doing a handstand in the snow? Don't try this at home, bro.

description: A glossy digital portrait of a young woman with a curved headset over her ears, her cheeks and eyelids dusted with rainbow-coloured glitter, sitting inside rings of coloured light on a dark starry background.
true_sentence: So much glitter! She will find it on her pillow for a year.
false_sentence: So much sand! She will find it on her pillow for a year.

description: A neon-blue anime boy wearing glowing headphones stares forward, surrounded on every side by luminous circuit-board lines and chips.
true_sentence: Circuits everywhere, and he still can't find the wifi.
false_sentence: Flowers everywhere, and he still can't find the wifi.
